info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Hotel Loyalty Points Balances-v4-spec
info.description: The Hotel Loyalty Points Balance API provides access to retrieve the current loyalty points balances for hotel members. This endpoint allows hotel loyalty program participants to track their points and rewards, ensuring they remain informed about their status. Typical consumers of this API include hotel management systems, mobile applications for guests, and customer support platforms, aiding in promoting customer engagement and satisfaction. The API facilitates seamless integration into various services, enhancing the overall guest experience while managing loyalty programs effectively.

get.summary: Retrieve the balance of points for a user.
get.description: This endpoint allows the user to fetch their current points balance. It provides real-time information regarding the total points accrued, which can be used for various rewards and benefits.
